d.d: One of three levels of a human being, the spirit, along with the body and soul.
Of, relating to, or resembling air or other gases
Powered by, or filled with, compressed air
In the gnostic theologian Valentinus' triadic grouping of man, the highest type; a person focused on spiritual reality (the other two being hylic and psychic).
The branch of mechanics that deals with the mechanical properties of gases
Of, pertaining to or caused by a pneumococcus bacterium.
Inflammation of the lungs caused by viruses, bacteria or other infectious microorganisms.
Of, or relating to the lungs; pulmonary.
A medicine to treat lung disease.
Presence of air inside the pleural cavity, usually caused by injury either to the lung or the chest wall.
